## Current-head hosted evidence (not a product assertion failure)

PR #291 remains at `7a3fffd937ad47a54fb9aecc9bff42e537b2036d` when rechecked 2026-10-27 17:46 UTC. Its [lifecycle job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/actions/runs/40535669186/job/122300112202) failed at 16:42 UTC before the first linked lifecycle model executed. The dependent `test` job is skipped, not passing.

The retained log reports:

- `failure_category: trust_refusal`
- `source_ref=feat/append-only-release-corrections, current_ref=unknown`
- `testing.allow_untrusted_linked_tests=true` is required in addition to the supplied CLI flag, or the current commands must be explicitly acknowledged.
- `assertion_failure: 0`, `recorded: false`, and `trusted: false`.

The [exact workflow](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/7a3fffd937ad47a54fb9aecc9bff42e537b2036d/.github/workflows/ci.yml) creates a fresh temporary HOME and invokes:
`node node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/cli.js test pmc-release-corrections --run --only-last --progress --allow-untrusted-linked-tests --timeout 1200`.
It does not establish the required linked-command trust in that isolated CI context first. The following linked command, behavioral revert proof, packed acceptance checks and full dependent gates therefore do not run.

## Expected / actual and impact

The [canonical release-corrections item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/7a3fffd937ad47a54fb9aecc9bff42e537b2036d/.agents/pm/features/pmc-release-corrections.toon) requires the focused lifecycle/revert/packed evidence before full Node22/26 npm/Bun gates, preserving truthful exact-head verification and prior thresholds. Expected: reviewed CI commands execute under an explicitly established, narrowly scoped trust contract. Actual: the required gate stops at trust admission, leaving current-head model and release evidence incomplete.

This is a CI setup blocker supported by hosted logs and static source, not a locally reproduced runtime defect, failed lifecycle assertion, or evidence that released consumers are broken. The trust refusal itself is correct fail-closed behavior.

## Acceptance / regression criteria

- Establish explicit trust for the reviewed linked commands in the disposable CI context using the supported SDK/CLI trust mechanism, without weakening user/default trust policy or inheriting credentials.
- Cover the fresh-HOME, detached/unknown-ref CI case and retain refusal for genuinely unacknowledged foreign commands.
- Re-run the exact new head: both linked checks, behavioral revert proofs, fixed models, packed checks and dependent Node22/26 npm/Bun gates. Record actual counts and links, not queued/past-head results.
- Preserve existing coverage thresholds, assertions, environment isolation and truthful incomplete status until these gates execute.

Deduplication: all 293 all-status issue/PR records, current PR conversation/inline comments and the canonical feature record checked. No dedicated equivalent trust-admission CI blocker found. PR #291 remains the implementation owner. No settings, source, provider state or trust configuration was modified during this review.
